Who we are:

Founded in 2003, Mobysoft provides data-based insight solutions to a wide range of social housing clients, supplying technology to help landlords to improve their income-collection processes for the good of all involved. Mobysoft delivers two market-leading products, which help keep tenants housed in a home they can enjoy and simultaneously improves rent collection for the long term good of the organisation.

Our vision is working towards a world in which intelligent technology significantly improves the quality of life for people who live in social housing and our mission is delivering accurate actionable data insights that help social housing providers to deliver a more consistent and equitable service

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Regional Director (New Business) who will be responsible for all new sales of RepairSense and RentSense into social housing providers (housing associations/councils & ALMO’s)

The successful person will be responsible for the annual new business sales target that includes both RepairSense and RentSense and any modules into net new clients

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and report to the Chief Commercial Officer on a weekly basis the core KPI’s for the role that include executive meetings booked, remote data tests booked, new sales conversion rates and new business revenue (quarter and annual)

  • Selling into new social housing providers across the UK & NI

  • Responsible for identification of the ‘Key Decision Makers’ (KDM’s) across these organisations and creating a sales contact plan to gain access and book an initial executive meeting

  • Supported by Marketing, Commercial Director, Account Directors and various other roles across the Repairs team

  • Seeking out major clients and forming working relationships with the key executives at enterprise/strategic prospects

  • Accurately forecasting future sales and forming sales plans to adapt to constant shifts in the marketplace

  • Forecasting to the Commercial Director on a weekly basis

Utilisation of the CRM (SF.com) system to drive new sales to conclusion, ensuring that all meaningful interaction and data is stored in the system

Serving as a business representative at major industry events, conferences, trade shows, and expositions

Maximising company profitability

Foreseeing and developing new sales strategies to drive increased value to the prospect and thus increase pricing

Forming sales strategies to keep your company competitive and innovative

Working with the implementation/pre-sales to deliver the Remote Data Tests

Constructing winning, viable, commercial offers/business case report for prospects

Working with marketing department to develop customer references/case studies and collating a body of client speakers & new business plan to unlock new prospects

Updating regular reports for Board presentations

  • Following the quality ethos set by Mobysoft and collaborating regularly with client service and technology teams

Values and Self Development

  • Role models the organisation’s culture of diversity in all its forms including diversity of thought processes.

  • Acts in accordance with Mobysoft’s values at all times and promotes these both internally and externally.

Qualifications and skills

Required

  • Ideally 4-5 years’ experience in IT- SAAS environment

    Proven sales executive experience meeting or exceeding targets

  • Ability to communicate, present and influence all levels of the organisation, including executive and C-level

  • Proven ability to drive the sales process from plan to close

  • Proven ability to articulate the distinct aspects of products and services

  • Proven ability to position products against competitors

  • Demonstrable experience senior business development director, developing client-focused, differentiated, and achievable solutions

  • Strong persuasion and negotiation skills to achieve the optimum outcome for Mobysoft

  • Strong and effective presentation skills

  • Strong commercial awareness and sound understanding of project dynamics

  • Ability to operate in a competitive and pressurised environment, making sensible decisions that do not compromise Mobysoft

  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and operate flexible working patterns to accommodate demand

  • Ability to quickly identify with the culture of client organisations

  • Ability to identify and influence decision makers and build relationships at senior business levels

  • Ability to think and communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing

The Person

  • Ambitious and energetic, with strong inter-personal skills

  • Self-motivated, enthusiastic, and business development focused

  • Affable, credible and can communicate effectively with clients and colleagues including formal presentations

  • Good team player capable of delivering results in less than perfect circumstances

  • Excellent communications skills and an ability to build trusted relationships with prospects who operate at senior levels within their organisation.

  • Persuasive – will be working in an extremely competitive environment requiring an ability to articulate an innovative, compelling, and differentiating offer

  • Strong commercial and entrepreneurial qualities

  • Highly customer focused and relationship driven

  • Highly flexible (including willingness to work away from home base)

  • Proactive with respect to personal development

  • A positive "can do" attitude to overcoming commercial, technical, and staffing challenges facing Mobysoft and prospects

Key Success Criteria:

Customer-focused: We drive outcomes that create value for the customer. We continually challenge ourselves on ‘what’s in it for the customer’. We drive win/win/win solutions.

Collaborative: We operate as one, fostering open communication, diverse contribution, cooperation and trust. We inspire teams towards a common goal for success.

Performance Marketing Strategist

**This is a remote, work-from-home position.

83bar manages patient education, navigation, and acquisition campaigns for some of the largest, most dynamic wellness and health brands in the world. We are seeking someone who is knowledgeable, personable, and a great communicator who is capable of designing and leading high-performing paid user acquisition campaigns.

What you'll do:

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded Performance Media Specialist with exceptional critical thinking skills to join our marketing team. This role is essential in ensuring the seamless execution and optimization of our DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) and Clinical Trial marketing campaigns through meticulous planning, insightful reporting, and comprehensive collaboration. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in marketing automation, combined with the ability to think strategically and align marketing processes with overall business goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute digital strategies that optimize patient recruitment, lead generation, and engagement workflows across multiple touchpoints.
  • Develop comprehensive end-to-end patient journey maps in Lucidchart, visualizing the full funnel from awareness to activation, including all communication, media, and operational touchpoints.
  • Architect funnel frameworks that align paid, organic, and outreach pathways to optimize conversion, qualification, and activation rates.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with strategy, media, creative, site managers, and call center teams to ensure Lucidcharts accurately reflect live process flows and identify bottlenecks or optimization opportunities.
  • Integrate and refine landing pages, surveys, email/SMS sequences, and automation workflows to enhance lead flow and conversion rates.
  • Analyze and optimize patient journeys, conversion points, and user experiences to minimize drop-offs and improve activation rates.
  • Oversee tracking implementation and attribution models, ensuring accurate data flow between platforms, CRMs, and analytics tools.
  • Identify and troubleshoot data inconsistencies, tracking errors, and reporting discrepancies to maintain campaign integrity.
  • Develop bi-weekly performance reports and data visualizations using SiSense, Google Analytics, and other reporting tools.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (creative, paid media, patient engagement specialist, outreach teams) to align messaging, user experience, and engagement strategies.
  • Work with SiSense and automation platforms to refine lead management, segmentation, and personalized engagement.
  • Design and implement A/B testing roadmaps to refine messaging, user flows, and engagement tactics based on performance insights.
  • Ensure compliance with healthcare, clinical trial, and digital marketing regulations, maintaining adherence to industry best practices.
  • Stay ahead of emerging digital trends, AI-powered tools, and automation advancements to continuously improve efficiency and impact.
  • Standardize best practices to ensure scalable, repeatable workflows for digital engagement and conversion optimization.
  • Leverage AI-driven analytics and automation to enhance data modeling, predictive analytics, engagement, and personalization strategies.

Requirements

  • Proven experience (4+ years) in digital strategy, lead generation, or conversion optimization.
  • Strong understanding of customer journeys and full-funnel engagement strategies.
  • Experience in tracking, attribution, and data flow management across digital ecosystems.
  • Proficient in SiSesnse, Google Analytics, LookerStudio, Tableau, and CRM platforms.
  • Familiarity with survey logic, automation workflows, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Strong ability to analyze and visualize performance data and make data-driven optimizations.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at managing multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Critical thinking, problem-solving, and adaptability in fast-paced environments.
  • Preferred: BS/BA in Marketing, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Bonus Skills:

  • Experience with survey logic, AI. automation, and/or interactive patient engagement tools to enhance digital experiences.

Job Summary

Job Description

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Workday Integration Analyst to join our HR Technology team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining Workday integrations that support HR business processes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, and other integration tools, along with strong analytical and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of complex Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, and Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Collaborate with HR, Payroll, Finance, Benefits, IT teams etc. to gather requirements and deliver scalable integration solutions.
  • Monitor and maintain existing integrations, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements.
  • Ensure data integrity and security across all integrations.
  • Manage integration lifecycle including documentation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Stay current with Workday releases and recommend improvements or new features.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior analysts and developers.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in Workday integrations, including hands-on experience with Workday Studio.
  • Strong understanding of XML, XSLT, XPath, and web service technologies (SOAP, REST).
  • Experience with Workday Core Connectors, EIBs, and Workday Web Services.
  • Proficiency in data mapping, transformation, and troubleshooting integration errors.
  • Experience with DIS-based integration system.
  • Integration/Reporting domain experience in HR, Payroll, Benefits, Talent, Learning and Compensation.
  • Experience with Integration using Cloud Connect to take advantage of Workday Web Services.
  • Proficiency in creating and editing Business Process, Custom Reports and Dashboards.
  • Ability to create BIRT reports, Report Groups, and Composite Reports.
  • Understanding of integration security including authentication, authorization, and encryption.
  • Experience implementing secure data transfer protocols and managing access controls.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Effective presentation skills for conveying technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Required Workday Certifications

  • Workday Integration Core
  • Workday Studio

Preferred Workday Certifications

  • Workday Cloud Connect for HCM and Payroll
  • Workday Reporting and Prism Analytics (a plus)

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with UKG Dimensions integrations and configuration.
  • Familiarity with UKG Dimensions APIs, data structures, and configuration.
  • Understanding of timekeeping, scheduling, and workforce management processes.
  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying integrations using Dell Boomi AtomSphere.
  • Ability to build and manage Boomi processes, connectors, and data mappings.
  • Experience with Boomi error handling, logging, and performance optimization.
  • Knowledge of Boomi’s role in middleware architecture and integration orchestration.
  • Experience with Workday Extend or Workday Orchestrate.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA or ServiceNow.
  • Knowledge of security protocols and data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).

raw.description:
Regulatory Affairs Manager

  1. Job purpose

Reporting to the Director of Regulatory Affairs, the Regulatory Affairs Manager is responsible for executing regulatory strategies, ensuring compliance with global regulations and leading the process to obtain and maintain market approval for DeepHealth’s product and product development and regulatory activities to commercialize new digital products, including AI technologies. This position will provide regulatory input on design and development activities to cross-functional teams, to ensure compliance with the relevant regulatory requirements and interactions with regulatory authorities.

  1. Duties and responsibilities

As the Regulatory Affairs Manager, this position will:

  • Oversee the day-to-day functions of the India based Regulatory Affairs team members.

  • Contribute to and execute the regulatory strategies for existing, new and modified medical and non-medical devices.

  • Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross functional project teams and provide strategic input and technical guidance on product lifecycle planning and regulatory requirements for non-medical devices, and medical device.

  • Leads and manages regulatory submissions, including US 510(k)s submissions, and technical files for CE marking, including Regulatory Body interactions.

  • Mentor and provide guidance to their direct reports and cross-functional product development teams on regulatory requirements, specifically for the US, UK, and EU markets.

  • Work closely with business partners and regulatory team members to ensure compliance for and support of OUS regulatory submissions and filings.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving global regulations, standards, and guidance documents to ensure the company’s regulatory compliance, translating them into action steps for the organization.

  • Assist in SOP development and review in support of "next-gen" product offerings.

  • Create and ensure maintenance of technical documentation (such as clinical evaluation reports, risk management reports, 510(k) notification) as required for obtaining and/or maintaining regulatory approval/clearance for DeepHealth products

  • Evaluate proposed design, labeling, and distribution changes for regulatory impact and implement any required regulatory action.

  • Ensure compliance with product post marketing requirements.

Please Note: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

  1. Working conditions

This position may be based in India in a typical office setting.

This position will have the ability to work remotely.

  1. Physical requirements

This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally. The position requires the ability to travel (~10% of time), drive a vehicle, and utilize other forms of transportation.

Requirements

  1. Qualifications

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (or equivalent experience)

  • 8 - 10 years working in a regulated industry (FDA and Software as a Medical Device preferred).

  • Strong knowledge of FDA Quality System Regulations, including but not limited to, 21 CFR 11, and 21 CFR 820.

  • Knowledge and experience drafting and submitting regulatory filings, including but not limited to, Q-Submission requests, and Traditional and Special 510(k) filings for Software as Medical Device.

  • Experience with US FDA Class I and II medical devices. Additional experience with FDA Class III devices and OUS device classification a plus.

  • Experience interacting with US and OUS Regulatory Authorities, including Q-Submission meetings, and product Deficiency Response meetings, and regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge and understanding of pre- and post- market clinical studies, including but not limited to, 21 CFR 812, 21 CFR 50, and 21 CFR 56.

  • Knowledge and understanding of Medical Devices Regulations (MDR 2017/745. MDCG 2019-11, MDCG 2020-1), ISO 13485, and MDSAP, ISO 14971, ISO 62366, IEC 82304-1, IEC 62304, preferred.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Job Description Summary

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

A successful Bilingual Customer Service Representative plays a pivotal role in ensuring positive customer experiences and maintaining strong relationships between the company and its clients. Reporting to the Customer Service Manager and/or Supervisor/Team Lead this position requires exceptional communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a dedication to customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate will exhibit professionalism, empathy, and the capability to handle a variety of customer inquiries and issues efficiently.

Schedule:

Training period:Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM (EST)

Regular shift after training:Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM (EST)

Start date:January 19, 2026

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Interaction: Engage with customers through various channels (phone, email, chat, or in person) in a friendly, empathetic, and professional manner to understand their needs and concerns. Ensuring clarity and customers are well informed on all inquiries.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with colleagues, sharing knowledge and insights to provide consistent and exceptional customer service
  • Issue Resolution: Resolve customer inquiries, concerns, or complaints effectively, striving for first-contact resolution. Escalate complex issues to appropriate channels when necessary
  • Product Knowledge/Adherence to Policies: Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, services, policies, and procedures to provide accurate information and guidance to customers. Ensure compliance with ALL Medline policies, including privacy and data security
  • Problem-Solving: Analyze customer issues and provide creative solutions to meet their needs while adhering to company policies and guidelines
  • Documentation: Accurately document customer interactions, including issues and resolutions, according to Medline’s database and contact center platforms
  • Feedback Handling: Gather and relay customer feedback to relevant departments for continuous improvement of products and services
  • Department Collaboration: Work effective with intercompany departments to ensure a consistent and high-quality customer experience with smooth customer orders, product flow, shipping issues and/or other inquiries

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in the Customer Service field; Bilingual Contact Center a strong asset
  • Due to the scope of responsibilities and/or the organizational structure, this position requires advanced language skills in both French and English (Bilingual).
  • Exceptional phone contact handling and active listening skills with a strong problem resolution background
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task, prioritize and effectively manage priorities while working effectively in a team environment and/or independently
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills (verbal and written)
  • Ability to work under pressure in an ever changing, fast-paced and dynamic medical environment
  • Demonstrates a highly developed sense of integrity and commitment to customer satisfaction
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Able to be self-motivated and directed, to effectively prioritize and execute task in a high pressure environment
  • Strong proficiency is a MUST with Microsoft Word, and other Office applications, including CRM systems and practices (experience in SAP a strong asset)

$50,200.00 - $75,400.00 Annual

English is required due to the scope of the role.
